name: Joe Terror
storyline:
Donald Jr goes to the playground with his mom to meet his friends. They have a great time playing together, but during a break to go to the restroom, something strange happens. When he comes back, he can't find anyone. Everyone has disappeared, leaving behind only silence.

Oh, I almost forgot to mention, there’s one other presence left: JOE and his prisoner ball, HUNTER. The playground has transformed into a mysterious and eerie place, and it's up to Donald Jr to navigate through various challenges, solve puzzles, and uncover clues to figure out what happened.

Will you help Donald Jr bring back the joy and laughter to the playground, or will the silence remain forever?
